answer: Sybil resistance binds every claimed identity to continuous, fresh challenges requiring prescribed chains of modular squarings. Each result depends on the previous one, so an attacker simulating clones cannot divide a chain across GPUs or reduce its wall-clock delay; additional identities multiply the sequential work and physical time required. Names such as saffron, hollow, and shale gain no advantage, while a Wesolowski proof lets verifiers check each completed delay succinctly.
